subject.title: Feature: Floating agent bubbles (Clawi) for macOS

question: Should the first-party macOS app add persistent per-agent floating desktop bubbles, or keep agent visibility and chat entry within the existing menu-bar and WebChat surfaces?
rationale: This choice changes the permanent macOS interaction model, window lifecycle, accessibility contract, and agent/session routing UX; source inspection establishes feasibility but cannot determine product intent.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded bubble design
options.body: Approve a native specification and prototype using canonical Gateway activity and explicit agent-targeted chat routing before committing to the full interaction set.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces
options.body: Decline persistent desktop bubbles and improve multi-agent visibility and switching within the menu bar and WebChat instead.

options.title: Support an external companion seam
options.body: Define only any missing native activity or chat-routing API needed by maintained external overlays if first-party bubbles are out of scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded bubble design
recommendation.body: Approve a native specification and prototype using canonical Gateway activity and explicit agent-targeted chat routing before committing to the full interaction set.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the explicit product lead, was directly requested on this issue, and has history in the adjacent macOS UI surfaces.
